title: Pure Diabellstar

allow.WANTED: Seeker of Sinful Spoils: Shared Sinful Spoils card that searches Diabellstar by name; the page's opening.
allow.Sinful Spoils of Betrayal - Silvera: Shared Sinful Spoils card that sends a Diabellstar to negate, and protects Diabellstar effects from the GY.
allow.Guilt of the Sinful Spoils: Shared Sinful Spoils card that only works while you control a Diabellstar Monster Card.
allow.Sinful Spoils of Doom - Rciela: Shared Sinful Spoils card built for a Level 7 or higher Spellcaster, which Diabellstar the Black Witch is.
allow.Sinful Spoils Subdual: Shared Sinful Spoils card: fetches the Level 7 and 8 Illusion witches, Diabellze the White Witch and the Original Sinkeeper.
allow.Sinful Spoils Sanctification: Shared Sinful Spoils card that revives a Diabell monster by name.
allow.Sinful Spoils of Slumber - Morrian: Shared Sinful Spoils card the Diabellze Illusions let you set again from the GY.
allow.Sinful Spoils Struggle: Shared Sinful Spoils card: Diabellstar's milling and setting fills the GY it counts.
allow.Susurrus of the Sinful Spoils: Shared Sinful Spoils card: swaps a Diabell Spellcaster or Illusion for one in the GY or banishment.

summary: The Diabell witches at full count, with the shared Sinful Spoils Spells and Traps that name or serve them and generic staples. The Azamina Fusions and the White Forest Synchros have their own lists, and the page's Snake-Eye and R-ACE partners are left out. WANTED: Seeker of Sinful Spoils searches Diabellstar the Black Witch, which summons itself by sending a card and sets a Sinful Spoils Spell/Trap from the Deck. The 2025 pair leads. Diabellze the White Witch summons itself by sending a Spell/Trap and mills a Sinful Spoils or Diabell card, and with two Diabell monsters out, your monsters can't be destroyed by the opponent's effects. Diabellstar Vengeance comes back by banishing a Spell and a Trap and pays half your LP to destroy a card on either turn. The page's end board leads into Baronne de Fleur, which is Forbidden in the TCG. Original Sinful Spoils - Snake-Eye is Forbidden as well.

exclude.Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils: Not yet released in the TCG.
exclude.Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Fore: Not yet released in the TCG.
